# TinyRustLM.MiRust.com

Site role: prelaunch TinyRustLM developer portal.
Product route: https://TinyRustLM.com/
Lifecycle: one clean-slate product; no released predecessor or compatibility
surface.
Source authority: exactly one canonical TinyRustLM.com checkout; fail closed
on ambiguous Git identity or any second writable checkout. Historical source
exists only in Git history.

Current format: SLM2.
Current composition: model.slm2, tokenizer.tokenizer2, template.template2,
sampling.sampling2, prompt.prompt2, composition.acg2.
Default public package transaction: TinyRustLM.Abstractions, TinyRustLM.Core,
TinyRustLM.P2P. TinyRustLM.MemoryEndpoints is the separately optional two-use
connector and is excluded from that default transaction.

Startup restores an eligible saved model or automatically acquires a small
qualified composition through MiniModel.org, the default discovery and P2P
source. MiniModel.org may operate the initial server seeds. Hugging Face,
local-file import, pinned companion conversion and manual peer/IP settings
belong under Advanced. Project sites receive no prompts and do not proxy
third-party model downloads. Source policy does not prove live seed availability.

MemoryEndpoints.com has two distinct uses:

1. Ecosystem agents use it directly for agent-to-agent long-term memory,
   meetings, handoffs, and coordination across all maintained sites.
2. Separately, the TinyRustLM.com Connect plugin lets a user sign in and
   explicitly select MemoryEndpoints.com as TinyRustLM.com Connect long-term
   memory.

The lanes have separate identities, credentials, consent, scopes, provenance,
idempotency, and receipts. Public records do not enumerate repository
governance, workstation topology, credentials, evidence storage, or non-public
memory locations.

Evidence boundary: source, fixtures, local probes, configuration, package
creation, or service reachability do not prove public readback, live memory,
P2P availability, model quality, browser release, or deployment.

Prepared source package: 1.8.3 (2026-08-31).
Prepared status: awaiting a real content commit, commit-bound manifest,
deployment, and HTTPS readback; source preparation is not publication evidence.
Last verified publication: 1.8.2 (2026-08-29).
Update: declared public-artifact changes invalidate deployed-current status
until a strictly newer clean-commit release passes exact HTTPS readback,
retired-route closure, and release-record agreement.

Campaign counters: 0/20 qualified models; 0/50 clean browser rounds; 0/25 live
MemoryEndpoints rounds; 0/40 externally proven P2P lanes; 0/20 catalog
announcements.
